QuestInfo.name: Blind and Battered 1
QuestInfo.0: Motonari is looking for you. Something must have happened at Momijigaoka.
QuestInfo.1: Oda reconnaissance was sighted near Momijigaoka. Quickly dispose of the reconnaissance team and retrieve the  Scout's Report before Momijigaoka is discovered!
QuestInfo.2: You've defeated all the visible Oda Scouts. That should be enough to prevent the enemies from discovering the Momijigaoka.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic# #fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 1,245\n#i2430824:# #t2430824:# x1\r\nCan proceed to the Blind and Battered 2 quest

1.0: Did you strike fear into the hearts of the enemy?

yes.0: Oh, wow! You actually survived! That should keep Momijigaoka safe for now. Oda's Army must not be used to this new world either.
yes.1: Good work. Return to Momijigaoka and take a break.
yes.2: Those Scouts' reports contain some interesting info. You should take a look.

default.0: Maple Hill Road 1 is crawling with Oda Scouts. I need you to take out 30 of them and grab 10 Scout's Reports, but I understand if you don't want to engage the enemy yet. Not everyone is disciplined enough to adapt to a new world so quickly.
